data.name: Navrang
data.gender_notes: Navrang is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Navrang refers to the nine fundamental emotions or rasas in Hindu philosophy. These emotions are Sringar (love), Hasya (laughter), Raudra (anger), Karuna (compassion), Veer (heroism), Adbhut (wonder), Shantha (peace), Bibhatsa (fear), and Shoka (sorrow). The name Navrang carries the meaning “Nine forms, colors, or emotions” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Navrang usually hope their child will grow to embody nine forms, colors, or emotions and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the nine fundamental emotions in life.
data.etymology: Navrang belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nine forms, colors, or emotions.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Navrang total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
